title: Why SQLite in Production Is Actually Genius

scenes.narration: Are you still paying thousands for managed cloud databases when your entire dataset easily fits in memory? SQLite in production is making a massive comeback across modern engineering teams.

props.title: SQLite in Production
props.subtitle: Why embedding your database inside your app is the ultimate 2026 architecture

scenes.narration: Traditional client-server databases spend ninety percent of their query time on network hops, TLS handshakes, and connection pools. SQLite runs inside your process, executing queries in twenty microseconds flat.

props.title: NETWORK HOP TAX

leftPane.title: Cloud RDS (Postgres / MySQL)

props.bottomSubtext: Eliminating network roundtrips beats any query index optimization.

scenes.narration: With modern distributed tools like LiteFS and Turso, write-ahead logs replicate continuously to worldwide edge instances. Your app reads locally with zero latency, while writes synchronize seamlessly.
